# Work Templates - Downloadable Assets

This directory contains downloadable template files (.md and .docx) that are served as static files and **not processed by MkDocs**.
page_texts.2:
[resources/work-templates/assets/README.md#purpose]

## Purpose

Files in this directory are:

- ✅ **Downloadable** - Users can click links to download files directly
- ✅ **Not Converted** - Markdown files stay as `.md`, not converted to HTML
- ✅ **Version-Controlled** - Part of the Git repository
- ✅ **Automatically Deployed** - Synced during CI/CD builds
page_texts.3:
[resources/work-templates/assets/README.md#directory-structure]

## Directory Structure

```
assets/
├── assessments/           # Assessment and evaluation templates
├── governance/            # Governance review templates
└── workshops/             # Workshop facilitation templates
```

**Simplified Structure:** Template files are organized by category (assessments, governance, workshops) without deep nesting for easier maintenance and access.
page_texts.4: [resources/work-templates/assets/README.md#usage-in-documentation] ## Usage in Documentation To link to downloadable templates from README files, use HTML anchors with the `download` attribute to force browser download: ```html Download Markdown Template Download Word Template ```
page_texts.5:
[resources/work-templates/assets/README.md#maintenance]

## Maintenance

When adding new templates:

1. **Place templates here**: Add both `.md` and `.docx` versions to the appropriate category folder
2. **Use descriptive names**: Name files clearly (e.g., `eap-maturity.md`, `app-modernization.md`)
3. **Update README files**: Add download links in the corresponding work-templates README
4. **Test links**: Verify that download links work after deployment
page_texts.6:
[resources/work-templates/assets/README.md#mkdocs-configuration]

## MkDocs Configuration

The `work-templates/assets/` directory is excluded from MkDocs processing via `exclude_docs` in `mkdocs.yml`:

```yaml
exclude_docs: |
  **/SYNTHESIA.txt
  work-templates/assets/**
```

This ensures files remain downloadable in their original format.
